# Changelog – Rose Gold Alloy v0.6.0

### New: Full Rose Gold Armor Set
A complete wearable armor tier has been added, establishing Rose Gold as a fully functional mid-tier metal.

Included:
• Rose Gold Helmet  
• Rose Gold Chestplate  
• Rose Gold Leggings  
• Rose Gold Boots  

The armor features:
• Protection values between Iron and Diamond  
• High enchantability (comparable to the tool tier)  
• Custom armor textures using the new 1.21+ equipment asset system  
• Unique visual identity with warm metallic tones  
• Proper repair material support via Rose Gold Ingots  
• Correct right-click and equip behavior

### Visual Integration
• Added custom equipment asset JSON to ensure proper player-body rendering  
• Added humanoid and humanoid_leggings Rose Gold texture layers  
• Added full set of inventory item textures for the armor pieces

### Datagen Additions
• Automated generation of armor item models  
• Automated generation of armor recipes  
• Updated tags to include armor enchantability and repair logic

### Balance and Progression
• Armor placed firmly between Iron and Diamond in strength  
• Enchantability tuned to align with Rose Gold’s refined tier identity  
• Recipe unlocks integrated with advancement-style progression

### Internal Improvements
• Cleaned structure for future decorative Rose Gold block families  
• Updated roadmap to reflect a finite, parity-based mod scope  
• General cleanup and alignment with the new 1.21.10 equipment system

---

Rose Gold Alloy now offers a complete mid-tier equipment progression:  
ingots → tools → armor → block.

Next update (v0.7.0) will introduce decorative block variants and finalize the material’s building palette.

# Changelog – Rose Gold Alloy v0.4.1

This is the first public release of the mod.

### Added
• Introduced Rose Gold, a new crafted mid-tier alloy made from Copper, Gold and Amethyst
• Added Rose Gold Ingot and Rose Gold Block
• Implemented full tool set: Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel and Hoe
• Tools feature proper right-click actions (axe stripping, shovel pathing, hoe tilling)
• Added complete crafting progression for ingots, blocks and tools
• Integrated all items into the appropriate creative tabs
• Added full enchantment compatibility for sword and tools
• Included all required item/block models, recipes, tags and loot tables

### Notes
• Armor set, trim material and decorative Rose Gold variants are planned for future updates
• No world generation or biome changes – Rose Gold remains fully craftable and progression-based
